*Comprehensive stakeholder management tool*


## When to Use

Use when identifying and analyzing project stakeholders for engagement planning. Essential for projects with diverse stakeholder groups requiring differentiated communication and influence strategies.

## When NOT to Use

Avoid for projects with a single known stakeholder or when stakeholder analysis has already been completed and locked. Not needed for informal initiatives with minimal external engagement.
